title: AlloyDB: `trackActiveQueryPlan` Deprecated
summary: The `trackActiveQueryPlan` property within AlloyDB's `ObservabilityInstanceConfig` schema has been deprecated. Developers should plan to migrate away from using this feature.
details: The `trackActiveQueryPlan` boolean property, found within the `ObservabilityInstanceConfig` schema, is now explicitly marked as deprecated. While it may continue to function for a period, developers are advised to update their configurations to no longer rely on this field and anticipate its eventual removal. Consider alternative observability methods for active query plan tracking.
